Characteristics of Life
4.Living things respond–Interact with environment–Interact with other living things–Examples–Locomotion towards or away from chemical in unicellular organisms–Migration of birds based on season–Plants leaves moving towards the sun–https://youtu.be/z0I3174S8Xg
explanation: This slide describes the fourth characteristic of life: living things respond. Organisms interact with their environment and other living things. Examples of responses include unicellular organisms showing locomotion towards or away from a chemical stimulus, seasonal migration of birds, and plant leaves moving towards the sun (phototropism).

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of an organism responding to its environment as mentioned on the slide?
opts: A single cell undergoing cell division to create identical offspring
Plants moving their leaves towards the sun
Storing food in a lab refrigerator
questions.exp: The slide provides 'Plants leaves moving towards the sun' as an example of response.
